'''Moulds''' can be used to form a distinct object from a [[metal bar]], such as a [[holy symbol]] out of a [[silver bar]]. Moulds are most often used for crafting, though the ammo mould is used in conjunction with [[Smithing]].

Most of the moulds can be bought from [[crafting]] shops. In free-to-play one may be found in [[Al Kharid]] and the other one in [[Rimmington]]. The ammo mould can be bought from [[Nulodion]] in the west building at the dwarven mines (after [[Dwarf Cannon]]).
